subject: elapsed time
fact: The group had been climbing for around the third hour before emerging into the Overbright.
source_quote: I had stopped counting the steps somewhere around the third hour of climbing

subject: elapsed time
fact: The group had been traveling through the Underdark for months, though the exact duration is unknown.
source_quote: I genuinely cannot tell you how many months it had been

subject: Overbright elevation
fact: The group emerged from a tunnel into the Overbright, implying a significant vertical ascent from the Underdark.
source_quote: The tunnel mouth opened like a held breath finally released.

subject: Glabbagool count
fact: One Glabbagool, a gelatinous ooze, peered out of the bag of holding.
source_quote: Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward who was now a grey ooze

subject: party member count
fact: Eight individuals emerged from the tunnel: the narrator, Thorin, Grygum, Daz, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and two others.
source_quote: The others emerged around me. Thorin first... Grygum next... Daz came through last... The rest of our moltley crew followed, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and the rest of the folks

subject: bag of holding usage
fact: Grygum opened the bag of holding just enough for Glabbagool to peer out.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough

subject: sequence of emergence
fact: Thorin emerged first, Grygum next, Daz last, and the rest followed.
source_quote: Thorin first... Grygum next... Daz came through last... The rest of our moltley crew followed

subject: gold amount
fact: The party had more gold than they started with, though they had started with nothing.
source_quote: We had more of it than we had started with — which was not saying much, given that we had started with nothing

subject: elapsed time after emergence
fact: The weeks that followed blurred in the way that recovery blurs.
source_quote: The weeks that followed blurred in the way that recovery blurs

subject: elapsed time
fact: The group had months ahead of them before the next thing began.
source_quote: We had months ahead of us before the next thing began
